Stacked on #3 (canon-sort-lab). Wave-2's translation control was degenerate with the rotation arm under periodic boundaries (sealed BOUNDARY.md). This arm supplies the non-independent control: fixed zero-flush (Dirichlet) boundaries, where rotation is NOT a dynamical symmetry.

Prereg sealed in experiments/canon-fixed-boundary.mjs before any run; pins FAIL-first (ENOENT receipt) then 5/5 green.

- H1-F CONFIRMED: naive diverges t=1, 6000/6000 rows.
- H2-F CONFIRMED in the REQUIRED direction: canon chain ALSO diverges (6000/6000 rows; t=1 in 9/12, t=2 in 3/12 — projection can delay detection, never erase it). If canon had stayed invariant here, C-ROT would erase real dynamical signal = overclaim. Result: C-ROT invariance is tied to rotation being a true symmetry of the digested dynamics — exact where it holds (wave 2 periodic 0/6000), absent where it does not (this arm 6000/6000). Rule bounded on both sides; wave-2 H2 untouched (different dynamical system), sealed receipt re-verified by pin F5 every run.
- C-F CONFIRMED: equivariance broken (500/501 and 499/501 mismatch rows), translation ≠ rotated-run chain for every seed.
- ND guard not triggered (293-363 distinct states/seed).

Wave-2 results.json sealed receipt untouched. src/worker.js untouched. main untouched.
title: W3.1 control arm: C-ROT under fixed boundaries (honest boundary sealed)

## What
Pre-registered deterministic arm of W2.3 (semantic sort stands in for embedding sort): **does the receipt chain notice ring rotation?**

## Verdicts (verified at harvest by re-running every pin)
- **H1 CONFIRMED** — naive chain is origin-sensitive: first divergence at t=1, 500/500 rows divergent, all 4 seeds × 3 rotation offsets (6000/6000).
- **H2 CONFIRMED** — canon-rotation-sorted chain is origin-invariant: 0 divergent rows, identical tails across all rotations and seeds (e.g. seed 42 tail `7cdf4bd259d0ed69` for offsets 1/17/63).
- **Non-degeneracy guard PASS** — 501 distinct raw states per seed (INCONCLUSIVE escape hatch not triggered).
- **Pins 4/4** on harvest re-run; FAIL-first receipt sealed (pins written before the experiment existed → first run ENOENT, exit 1, log preserved).

## Canon-rule candidate C-ROT (minted, ready for fleet review)
> Digest the rotation-class representative (lex-min rotation), never the presented rotation — exact, not statistical; O(n²) naive / O(n) Booth at width 128; covers rotation only; adopt only after re-running these pins on the target substrate.

## Honest boundary (carried in BOUNDARY.md)
The translation control is degenerate with the rotation arm under periodic boundaries (on a ring, shift-by-k ≡ rotate-by-k — naive tails bit-identical, verified). The canon claim does not depend on it. A non-degenerate control needs fixed boundaries → wave-3.

Zero failures; experiment ran 0.47 s on node v24.16.0. Receipts in `receipts/wave2-canon-invariance/`. Main untouched.
title: W2.3-det: canon-rotation invariance of receipt chains (C-ROT canon-rule candidate)
